title: Polynomial-time computability of the AW operations
statement: For all natural-number parameters $C_w,c_w$ and every operation $A$ in the six-element set consisting of copying the second component of a decoded input, incrementing that component, producing an all-zero word of length $C_w(|x|+1)^{c_w}$, incrementing that all-zero word, producing the word of binary digits of the length of the fourth decoded component followed by zeros whose number is that component's length, or incrementing this last word, the resulting function on Boolean words is polynomial-time computable. In each increment case, an overflow is replaced by the empty word.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is one of the six specified operations
